# 03R · MiniMax H3 — persona video from reference views (no first frame, no LoRA)
**Use:** load the persona's canon views (front / three-quarter / profile on the mark side) → write the shot-list in **prompt**
and name them `<Picture 1>`–`<Picture 3>` as *identity references only* → Run → `video/H3_ref_*.mp4`.

Series 6b (Maren, 2 scenes × 2 seeds, ArcFace vs the hero): text only 0.26 · **these refs on FL2VA 0.56** · I2V from a LoRA
still 0.40 · Ref2VA checkpoint (19.5 GB, not installed) 0.68. FL2VA follows head turns the refs don't show (profile dips).

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| width / height | multiples of 32; 768×960 = series default |
| frames | 17k+5 → 124 = 5 s · 226 = 9 s |
| 2nd / 3rd reference | off = fewer views (front only is weakest on marks) |
| steps / shift / Sage | quality recipe of 03: 30 steps res_multistep, shift 12, Sage on |
| keep light | off by default: there is no first frame to match; on = match the hero's light (ColorMatch) |

**Prompt:** say the pictures are identity references "for face, freckles, mole and scar only — not for framing, outfit or
background"; describe outfit and scene in words. Don't add a first frame on top (two identities fight, series 6).
Don't run H3 here while the agent runs one on port 8189 (62 GB RAM is shared).

**Measured:** 9.4 s (226 f) 768×960, 30 steps, shift 12, no Sage: 910 s on a RunPod RTX 5090 (ArcFace 0.59 vs hero); local 5070 Ti not timed yet (Sage ≈ 2× faster)

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> show the same woman, Maren, from the front, three-quarter and profile: identity references for her face, freckles, mole and scar only — not for framing, outfit or background. Whole clip is 9 seconds. Live-action. Medium close-up of a fictional 29-year-old woman, Maren, laughing at a bar counter in warm tungsten light.
Appearance lock: long wavy copper-red hair, dense natural freckles, a tiny dark mole below her left eye, a thin pale scar line at her left eyebrow, green eyes, mature adult face, minimal makeup, black blouse. Keep her face and marks exactly as in <Picture 1>-<Picture 3>.
Background lock: the bar shelves and bottles stay in place; only soft bokeh lights and blurred guests move slightly.
[Shot 2] 0s-3s: her laugh fades into a warm smile, her right hand drops from her cheek to the counter.
[Shot 3] 3s-6s: she glances to her left at someone off-screen, nods, then looks back toward the camera.
[Shot 4] 6s-9s: she picks up the glass of beer from the counter with her right hand, takes a small sip, sets it down and smiles with closed lips.
camera: handheld, very slight natural sway, no zoom, no cuts.
overall_soundscape: busy bar ambience, glasses clinking, low chatter, her soft laugh at the start.
non_diegetic_music: None.
negative: nudity, revealing clothing, morphing face, identity drift, extra fingers, warped hands, glass merging with hand, flicker, jitter, text, subtitles, watermark, music, talking.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
### 1 · Models
- **official** `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot`; turbo 8-step LoRA as a **strength knob**: 0 = off = best quality
  (30 steps, res_multistep, shift 12 — series 1 winner); 0.8 + 12 steps = faster with a small loss; 1.0 + 8 steps = fastest, softest hands
- **Eros Max** beta5 int8 (community finetune, already turbo) + VBVR Pro attn-only @0.25 → for anatomy official H3 smears;
  ≈ 30 % softer, drifts darker (use *keep first-frame light*)
- text encoder `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq` (32 B → ~58 GB system RAM), video/audio VAEs
- **shift** (MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, audio 3): 8 = sharper; lower = softer, less darkening on Eros
- **SageAttention** (toggle, default on): 8-bit attention, ≈ 2× faster (9 s: 445 → 224 s), same motion and colour (series 1)

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
### 5 · Decode + finish
- **drop frame 0**: frame 0 is the input still itself (sharper, other colour) → visible pop
- **keep first-frame light**: ColorMatch mkl of every frame against the first frame — stops the slow darkening/warming drift
- **sound**: H3 audio through a volume stage; off = no audio track
- **smooth 48 fps**: FILM ×2 (core FrameInterpolate, ≈ 30 s per 9 s; beat RIFE 4.7/4.26 on fast hands in series 1); lazy switch, off = never runs
